title: Repair failure capture before lease quarantine without changing guard safety
scope: SD.md D1-D2 only. D3 (failure-path integration tests), D4-D6 (hosted TRACE/RCA, product FIX, durable diagnostics) and step 5 belong to separate follow-on tasks (DEV502-FAILPATH-001, DEV502-TRACE-001, DEV502-FIX-001, DEV502-OBSERVE-001, DEV502-STOP-001). No hosted dispatch was performed by this task.

root_cause.summary: The prior design ran failure diagnostics as a second, independent invocation of scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh (workflow step id paper_bootstrap_diagnostics) after the paper_bootstrap step had already failed. run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh's own EXIT trap (cleanup_command -> stop_heartbeat_for_quarantine) stops the lease heartbeat synchronously as soon as the first guarded command returns non-zero, so the second guard invocation always failed its own pre-flight heartbeat_is_healthy check with 'lease heartbeat is not healthy before command start', and the collector never ran.
exact_source_lines: .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml (pre-fix): separate paper_bootstrap_diagnostics step reused the same lease/heartbeat state files as a second guard invocation

prior_review_cycle.verdict: Acceptance defects: (P1 D1) scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh trapped EXIT INT TERM with cleanup only and resumed execution after TERM, triggering a second collector call after baseline cancellation/lease loss; (P1 D2) collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py accepted arbitrary Error/Exception suffixes and arbitrary dotted prefixes, emitting sentinels like SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_SENTINELError from request bodies as exception types; (P2 D2) wrapper validated only six field names with truthiness for identity_matches, accepting missing D2 fields, string false, invalid services, and null collected_at.

fix_design.d1_capture_inside_guarded_child: The baseline bootstrap and the failure collector run inside the same single guarded child (scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh), invoked once by run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh from the paper_bootstrap workflow step. The script captures the baseline's original exit status without `set -e`, and only if it is non-zero does it invoke the collector over the same SSH session while the guard still owns the lease and heartbeat. It always exits with the original baseline status (never `|| true`, never overridden by collector success/failure), so the guard's normal failure recording and quarantine behavior is unchanged.
fix_design.d1_pin_boundary: run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh remains the immutable pinned guard binary from .lease-controller (commit 9e564718da8c39199a4c311f1a667b74226e3428, hash-checked); it was not modified. The paper_bootstrap step's invocation matches the literal ${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.lease-controller/scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh form used by sibling guarded steps.

p1_raw_stderr_isolation.defect: Collector SSH stderr may contain sensitive tokens, passwords, or sentinels.
p1_raw_stderr_isolation.fix: Collector stderr is captured to a mktemp file outside DEV_PAPER_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR (removed by an EXIT trap). write_status() reads bounded raw bytes and maps them to allowlisted structural failure categories only (e.g. ssh_connection_timeout, collector_command_failed, etc.). No raw stderr strings enter collection-status.json. The workflow upload step uploads an explicit path list of fixed runner-local files (diagnostics.json, collection-status.json, SHA256SUMS).

p1_no_overall_collection_deadline.defect: The wrapper had no overall deadline around the collector's SSH exec; per-command 5s bounds inside collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py and any SSH ConnectTimeout cannot bound an already-connected, stalled remote channel.
p1_no_overall_collection_deadline.fix: The collector invocation is wrapped in `timeout --foreground --kill-after=5s <deadline>s`, where <deadline> defaults to 120 and is overridable via DEV_PAPER_DIAGNOSTICS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (validated numeric). A timeout/SIGKILL exit (124/137) is recorded as collectionStatus="timeout" and never mutates the preserved baseline exit status. Terminal evidence is initialized before baseline runs (collection-status.json written with collectionStatus="not_started"), so a cancellation or lease loss leaves durable evidence on disk.

p2_missing_run_identity_in_collector_cal.defect: The wrapper only ever passed --expected-bff-sha to the collector; run_id, attempt, phase, expected_fe_sha and bootstrap_exit were null.
p2_missing_run_identity_in_collector_cal.fix: The wrapper accepts and validates EXPECTED_FE_SHA, DEV_PAPER_RUN_ID, DEV_PAPER_ATTEMPT and DEV_PAPER_PHASE, and forwards them plus the captured bootstrap exit code as --expected-fe-sha/--run-id/--attempt/--phase/--bootstrap-exit to the collector. nonprod-deploy.yml's paper_bootstrap step supplies these from steps.frontend.outputs.sha, github.run_id, github.run_attempt and a fixed "paper_bootstrap" phase label.

p1_aggregate_status_omits_inspect_and_id.defect: collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py's aggregate collection_status only tracked docker-ps and docker-logs; inspect failures and identity mismatches were masked as ok.
p1_aggregate_status_omits_inspect_and_id.fix: container_state()'s collection_status feeds aggregate statuses. The aggregate result is "partial" if any command is non-ok, "identity_mismatch" if commands succeeded but observed operator-bff source SHA does not match the expected candidate, and only "ok" when both hold.

p1_timeout_foreground_pgid_containment.defect: GNU timeout without --foreground spawned a separate process group escaping the pinned guards COMMAND_PGID pause/termination authority (STOP/TERM/CONT/KILL).
p1_timeout_foreground_pgid_containment.fix: Added --foreground to timeout invocation in scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh, keeping all collector subprocesses within the guards COMMAND_PGID.

p1_allowlisted_structural_failure_fields.defect: Free-form stderr was copied into collection-status.json with incomplete denylist regex redaction, leaking JSON secret sentinels.
p1_allowlisted_structural_failure_fields.fix: Replaced free-form stderr copying in write_status with allowlisted structural failure categories only (collectorErrorCategory, collectorStderrSummary). No arbitrary stderr strings enter collection-status.json.

p1_workflow_upload_predeclared_paths_and.defect: Workflow upload step derived condition and file paths from step outputs written only after the guarded command, risking lost evidence if cancelled or timed out mid-flight.
p1_workflow_upload_predeclared_paths_and.fix: Predeclared deterministic runner-local directory ${RUNNER_TEMP}/dev-paper-diagnostics-${DEV_PAPER_RUN_ID}-${DEV_PAPER_ATTEMPT} and initialized collection-status.json (not_started) before guard invocation in .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml. Configured upload step with if: ${{ always() && steps.paper_bootstrap.conclusion != "skipped" }} and direct fixed runner paths.

p1_terminating_signal_handling_on_baseli.defect: scripts/run_dev_paper_baseline_with_diagnostics.sh trapped EXIT INT TERM with cleanup only and resumed execution after TERM, triggering a second collector call after baseline cancellation/lease loss while exiting 143.
p1_terminating_signal_handling_on_baseli.fix: Added terminating signal handling via `on_signal` trapping INT and TERM to clean up and re-signal self (`kill -s <sig> $$`), plus explicit early exit if bootstrap_status is 130 or 143. Baseline cancellation or lease loss terminates immediately without starting remote diagnostics, preserving the initial `collectionStatus="not_started"` runner evidence and leaving the guard unchanged.

p1_bounded_trusted_exception_allowlist_f.defect: scripts/collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py accepted arbitrary Error/Exception suffixes and arbitrary dotted prefixes, allowing request bodies containing SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_SENTINELError: ... to emit the sentinel as an exception type.
p1_bounded_trusted_exception_allowlist_f.fix: Replaced broad type/prefix regex admission with an explicit bounded allowlist of trusted Python built-in, standard library, psycopg, and Pantheon domain exception names (SD D2), strictly rejecting arbitrary Error/Exception suffixes and malicious dotted prefixes.

p2_strict_wrapper_d2_envelope_validation.defect: The wrapper validated only six field names with truthiness for identity_matches, accepting missing D2 fields (run_id, attempt, phase, bootstrap_exit, observed_source_sha, container_id, image_id), string false, string invalid services, and null collected_at as ok.
p2_strict_wrapper_d2_envelope_validation.fix: The wrapper Python validator now enforces all 14 required D2 fields and types, binds run_id, attempt, phase, bootstrap_exit, expected_bff_sha, expected_fe_sha to invocation parameters, strictly checks `isinstance(identity_matches, bool)`, `isinstance(services, dict)`, ISO-8601 UTC `collected_at`, and rejects malformed/missing evidence with schema_error.

overlap_and_scheduling.dev_delivery_001: DEV-DELIVERY-001 continues to hold the nonprod workflow/lease scope for FE release protocol; this task only touches the diagnostic-capture timing in nonprod-deploy.yml's dev paper baseline steps and does not modify the release/switch protocol. Both share the existing pantheon-dev exclusive resource and serialize through it.
overlap_and_scheduling.pinned_guard_unchanged: scripts/run_with_dev_environment_lease.sh was read but not modified; the pinned guard algorithm and its hash pin in nonprod-deploy.yml are untouched.

verification.note: Focused unit/contract/subprocess tests only. No hosted dispatch, no step 5, no live deploy run.

results.scripts/test_collect_dev_paper_diagnosti: 17 passed (including regressions for baseline cancellation signal handling, bounded trusted exception allowlist, and strict 14-field D2 envelope validation)

not_implemented_in_this_task: SD D3 executable failure-path subprocess tests against the real guard (DEV502-FAILPATH-001)
SD D1 lease-loss fallback best-effort capture after a new lease is acquired by compensation
SD D4-D6 hosted TRACE/RCA, product FIX, durable sanitized diagnostics
Step 5 full acceptance (explicitly on hold, DEV502-ACCEPTANCE-HOLD-001)

prior_review_cycles.verdict: D1 same-child timing and unchanged pinned guard were accepted as correct. D2 acceptance failed on four defects: raw stderr in upload dir, missing overall collection deadline, missing run identity in collector invocation, and aggregate status omitting inspect and identity.

Acceptance defects: (P1) timeout creates process group outside pinned guard COMMAND_PGID; (P1) free-form stderr copied after incomplete denylist redaction leaking JSON secret sentinels; (P2) wrapper treats all valid JSON as collectionStatus=ok, masking identity mismatches and missing schema; (P1) workflow upload derives paths and condition from post-command outputs, risking lost evidence on cancellation.

Acceptance defects: (P1 D1) wrapper trapped EXIT INT TERM with cleanup only and resumed execution after TERM, triggering a second collector call after baseline cancellation/lease loss; (P1 D2) collect_dev_paper_diagnostics.py accepted arbitrary Error/Exception suffixes and arbitrary dotted prefixes, emitting sentinels like SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_SENTINELError from request bodies as exception types; (P2 D2) wrapper validated only six field names with truthiness for identity_matches, accepting missing D2 fields, string false, invalid services, and null collected_at.
